board.title: Conference Board
board.intro: The Conference Co-Chairs oversee both the Advisory and Organization Committees, ensuring cohesive collaboration and the overall success of PharmaDS. Co-Chairs serve a two-year term.

advisory.title: Advisory Committee
advisory.intro: Senior leaders from the pharmaceutical industry, regulatory agencies, and academia who provide strategic direction, content leadership, and mentorship to the conference.

organization.title: Organization Committee
organization.intro: Dedicated volunteers from industry, regulatory bodies, and academia who manage the execution of the conference. The committee is organized into functional subteams.

subteams.description: Plans and structures conference sessions, including short courses, presentations, and poster competitions.
Identifies, invites, and coordinates with speakers, keynote presenters, and panelists.
Secures the conference venue and manages all day-of-event logistics.
Recruits, trains, and allocates volunteers across short courses, presentation sessions, and receptions.
Maintains and updates the conference website and digital platforms.
Identifies sponsors, secures funding, manages partner relationships, sets registration fees, and oversees the budget.
